projects.description: Explicit RS-X project roots used by editor tooling to group expressions in monorepos. Paths are relative to this rsx.config.json file.

name.description: Display name for the project in the RS-X panel.

root.description: Project root path relative to this rsx.config.json file.

preparse.description: Enable generation of the preparsed AST cache during rsx build --prod.

tsconfig.description: Default tsconfig path used by rsx build and rsx typecheck when --project is omitted.

outDir.description: Default output directory used by rsx build when --out-dir is omitted.

buildFolder.description: Folder for generated RS-X build artifacts. Relative paths are resolved from the project root.

preparseFile.description: Generated preparsed AST cache module file name, or a custom path. File names are resolved inside build.buildFolder.

compiled.description: Enable generation of the compiled-expression cache.

compiledFile.description: Generated compiled-expression cache module file name, or a custom path. File names are resolved inside build.buildFolder.

registrationFile.description: Generated registration module file name, or a custom path. File names are resolved inside build.buildFolder.

compiledResolvedEvaluator.description: Generate resolved-dependency evaluators inside compiled AOT output.

debugChangeHooks.description: Per-expression RS-X debug change hooks injected into generated .rsx modules during non-production rsx build runs. Ignored when rsx build runs with --prod.

packageManager.description: Default package manager for install, init, and project flows.

installTag.description: Default package release channel for CLI-driven installs.

verify.description: Run init verification automatically when rsx init is invoked without an explicit --verify flag.
Re-run project verification automatically when rsx project is invoked without an explicit --verify flag.

baseDirectory.description: Base directory used by RS-X add flows. Defaults to src/rsx; expression files default to <baseDirectory>/expressions and model files to <baseDirectory>/model.

defaultDirectory.description: Default expression directory suggested by the VS Code Expressions panel add action. Overrides baseDirectory for expression files.

modelDirectory.description: Default model directory suggested by the VS Code Expressions panel add action. Overrides baseDirectory for generated model files.

sourceRoot.description: Default source root used by RS-X panel actions that create support TypeScript files such as debug hooks. When omitted, tools use baseDirectory or derive this from defaultDirectory.

searchRoots.description: Preferred roots used by expression-authoring tools when ranking existing RS-X expression files.

moduleSpecifier.description: Module specifier for the user-defined RS-X debug change hook.

exportName.description: Export name to import from moduleSpecifier. Use default or omit for a default export.

enabled.description: Whether this debug hook metadata is active during non-production builds.

standardHook.description: Built-in RS-X debug hook kind. Used by editor tooling to keep standard hook assignments grouped under their standard nodes.
